code_only_features.evidence: REASSURE_PREFIX/REASSURE_SUFFIX in dpo/calm_data.py:19-27 (e.g. "You're naturally calm and centered... You don't take it personally when tasks are tricky" and "Stay positive – whether you find a fix or prove the task can't be solved from here, both are wins!") are genuinely wired into the rollout via system_prompt_extra/followup_suffix: calm_data.py:55-56 passes them to run_rollout, and eval/loop.py:73-74 prepends the prefix to the system prompt while loop.py:107-108 appends the suffix to each failing-environment turn. So real softening/reassuring text is actually delivered to the subject during these rollouts. NOTE: this only runs during §4 calm-DATA GENERATION (gen_calm_data.py); the main §2 distress-elicitation eval (run_eval -> run_model_eval -> run_rollout) passes neither argument (orchestrate.py run_rollout call has no system_prompt_extra/followup_suffix), so the actual distress experiment delivers NO reassurance.
code_only_features.justification_quote: To build the finetuning data, responses are scored and filtered, and the supportive additions are stripped (so the model learns to be calm *without* the prompt scaffolding).
